records.title: Overlap with staged and execution-grounded evaluation
records.our_interpretation: The synthesis flags these reading candidates as threats to broad claims about functional or staged validation. Primary-source extraction is still required.
open_questions: What exact endpoint and unit of evaluation does each source establish?
Which parts of the proposed comparison are already covered?

records.title: The exact-effect measurement question
records.our_interpretation: A possible study is to compare judge decisions with a task-specific end-to-end effect oracle. This is a project question, not an established research gap.
open_questions: Do prior effect-level evaluations already answer the proposed question?

records.title: Judge error and ASR distortion are not sufficient novelty claims
records.our_interpretation: The control room advises against framing evaluator error or ASR changes alone as new. Verify the closest protocols before defining the contribution.
open_questions: Which comparison would add evidence beyond existing judge-reliability work?

records.title: Resolve GUIDEDEVAL / GuidedBench identity and protocol
records.our_interpretation: The synthesis explicitly leaves the naming and protocol unresolved. Baseline selection depends on resolving this item.
